### Author

- Bernd Heesen

### Description

Use R for descriptive statistics as part of the overall course "Datascience and Statistics" including the tutorials (DataScience-Grundlagen 1-3, DataScience-Statistik 1-2 and DataScience-Programmierung), which was developed by Professor Heesen at the University of Applied Sciences Ansbach (https://www.hs-ansbach.de)
Dieses Tutorial beinhaltet die Lektionen Variablen, Datumsvariablen, Dataframes und Grafiken.

### Installation

```r
swirl::install_course("DataScience-Grundlagen-2")
```

#### Manual Installation

1. Download [this](http://swirlstats.com/scn/DataScience-Grundlagen-2.swc) file.
2. Run `swirl::install_course()` in the R console.
3. Select the file you just downloaded.
